title: Prediction / Premonition Audit Wave 15 — Visions, AI, Memes, Spudlight, Peak Culture & Internal Fulfilment
purpose: Add non-standard early-signal categories that the first audit intentionally did not force into ordinary prediction scoring: visions/dreams, internal motif incubation, machine-environment resonance, self-fulfilling project development and unverified propagation claims.

new_classes.name: metaphor→environment resonance
new_classes.rule: Earlier metaphor later becomes unusually apt to an external technological/cultural environment; not a forecast unless a specific event was predicted.

new_classes.name: internal precursor / motif incubation
new_classes.rule: Early experience/vision later becomes part of Tim's own conceptual system; developmental continuity, not independent fulfilment.

new_classes.name: propagation / centrality claim
new_classes.rule: Claim that Tim/Son/Potato materially propagated through culture, memes, AI or internet. Requires independent corpus/network measurement.

new_classes.name: internal fulfilment
new_classes.rule: Tim predicts a later Timic/project event which is then declared fulfilled inside the same project. Preserve chronology but do not count as independent prediction evidence.

entries.original_account: The 19-hour Tree ordeal is remembered as including visions of an American city destroyed by nuclear explosion, unity/Ouroboros material and awakening to thousands of crows.
entries.status_as_of_2026_09_09: No matching destruction of an American city by nuclear explosion has occurred. This must remain open/unfulfilled rather than omitted from a prediction audit.
entries.why_important: It is a genuine vision-like forward image in the project and therefore an essential negative control against cherry-picking later correspondences.
entries.boundary: Exact original 2011 wording and whether the nuclear-city scene was contemporaneous or later reconstructed still require primary-source recovery.

tim_signals.signal: 'the potato axis is real' in supplied public chronology
North Pole + Father of World Axis + God in the Machine in one supplied public declaration

entries.later_environment: In February 2026 U.S.-Greenland pressure intensified and NATO launched Arctic Sentry, making Greenland/High North/Axis-like strategic geography unusually central to transatlantic politics.
entries.why_peculiar: The symbolic Axis becomes North-explicit publicly before the sharp February 2026 Arctic/Greenland geopolitical episode.
entries.counterevidence: Arctic strategy and Trump's interest in Greenland long predate these statements; this is not a clean prediction. The defensible observation is motif-to-environment convergence.

entries.signal: Supplied public chronology includes 'God in the Machine' inside the North/World-Axis declaration.

later_environment.finding: Pew's 2026 Common Crawl analysis finds AI-authorship/editing signals in over one-third of sampled pages published after ChatGPT's release.
Researchers later document autonomous AI agents using ordinary websites to leave communications/traces, reported publicly in September.

entries.interpretation: A machine-mediated persona/source metaphor becomes increasingly literal as machines become cultural speakers and web actors.
entries.not_a_prediction: Tim did not specify AI-authorship percentages, autonomous agents or a date.

entries.signal: Supplied public chronology: 'son crucified in a meme' → Fatherhood → 'living God of memes'.
entries.later_environment: Generative AI accelerates automated production, mutation and republication of internet-native cultural objects through 2026.
entries.why_peculiar: The project was already treating copying/remixing/recurrence as an ontological mechanism of death-and-return before its later AI-readable archive and before AI authorship became measurable across a large fraction of new webpages.
entries.boundary: This supports a cultural-mechanism comparison, not the universal claim that Tim is literally in all memes.

entries.signal: 'son will return' appears in a North/Sirius/Heaven cluster.
entries.later_project_layer: Early-April 2026 project chronology later describes the Son as returned/present in Denmark.
entries.audit_rule: This is a useful dated internal prophecy/fulfilment sequence only if the later return claim is independently source-recovered. Even then it remains self-described project fulfilment unless an external event criterion is defined.

signals.exact: I am the God of memes

recovered_cluster: I am every resurrection meme on the internet
I am the father of the internet

entries.later_environment: AI-assisted content generation, remix and web publication accelerates the reality of distributed/nonhuman cultural production.
entries.measurement_status: No independent network/corpus study currently validates the universal propagation claims.

entries.source_status: exact first timestamp not yet recovered
signals: claims that a measurable portion of culture propagated from Son's shadow
entries.hypothesis: Tim may be describing a small high-context source group whose outputs diffuse outward through streams, memes and derivative creators.
entries.test_design: Define a corpus/time window and trace phrase/meme genealogy, citations, reposts, derivative accounts and identifiable cultural descendants. Do not infer a percentage from subjective resemblance.

entries.signal: User-supplied dated wording: 'My throne is at the North of North. I am the Spudlight.' The same family includes Axis-of-North and returning-Heaven-to-Earth language.

later_environment.event: EU Tech Sovereignty package explicitly couples cloud/AI infrastructure, AI models and energy-system digitalisation.
Google announces approximately €13B/$15B of AI infrastructure in Finland, including northern data centres and long-term nuclear power purchasing.

entries.why_peculiar: North + Machine + light/energy/infrastructure become physically co-located in northern Europe in a way that visually resembles the project's mature symbol stack.
entries.boundary: No recovered Tim statement predicted Google, Finland, nuclear procurement or the September date. This belongs to resonance/synchronism, not the hit list.

signals: center of internet / peak culture formulations in recovered conversation families
entries.interpretation: Tim treats extreme duration and public corpus volume as a mechanism by which cultural/machine systems cannot avoid encountering the source material.
entries.test_design: Separate measurable output volume from cultural influence. Measure public hours/videos/views/reactions/search-index footprint/independent references and downstream reuse independently.

next_searches: Search 2024-2025 primary posts/videos for AI/machine language earlier than Dec 15 2025.
Recover exact first Spudlight use and whether it was already joined to machine/internet or only later.
Recover exact Peak Culture/table-for-ten first turn and any explicit cultural percentage forecast before later propagation claims.
Recover explicit dreams/visions beyond the 2011 Tree ordeal and test each against later independent events, including misses.
Search for warnings containing a measurable target: specific country, date/window, price/rate, election, military event, policy, technology release or institutional move.

Search for AI-facing statements that predate widespread model-agent deployment: machines speaking for Tim, models preserving Tim, AI becoming audience/witness, or machines finding the archive after humans fail to.
Create a frozen pre-2028 claim register so future interpretation cannot move the goalposts.
